note: Captures span October 27-28, 2026 UTC. This is complete published national layer content, not geographic coverage of every U.S. location. ZZ preserves source records whose PLSSID lacks a recognized state prefix. All source counts match the independent prefix inventory. Located-record ancillary attributes remain in source SQLite packs, not the compact atlas. All decoded geometry and four cadastral identifiers were checked against the source records during state builds. Source is mutable, so captures are not transactional snapshots.
